SELECT C.NAME AS CATEGORY, P.SKU, P.NAME AS PRODUCT, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE YEAR(O.ORDER_DATE) = 2025 GROUP BY C.NAME, P.SKU, P.NAME ORDER BY C.NAME, SALES DESC
set session transaction isolation level repeatable read

SELECT C.NAME AS CATEGORY, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES, 100.0 * SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) / (SELECT SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE YEAR(O.ORDER_DATE) = 2025 ) AS SHARE FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE YEAR(O.ORDER_DATE) = 2025 GROUP BY C.NAME ORDER BY SALES DESC
